title: SalesOS Therapist Meeting Kit — Zero-State and Phased Build Plan

missing_salesos_runtime: coaching replay / Sales DNA / Human Performance Engine
zero_state.schema_caveat: sales_call_recordings, coaching_clips, real_time_coaching_events, and sales_technique_patterns currently FK boldtrail_agents(id) and include boldtrail-specific fields; a migration is required before SalesOS reuse.

steps.name: Lock Phase 0 decisions
steps.acceptance: Schema strategy, recording legal policy, lead magnet default, CRM ownership, outbound channel, data retention, queue priority, and HPE timing are documented and approved by founder.

steps.name: Lock discovery-phase decisions
steps.acceptance: Geographic scope for pilot (single Nevada territory), approved source allowlist for pilot (max 2 connectors), exhaustiveness definition, per-record budget ceiling, and dedup strategy against crm_contacts are documented and approved by founder before any discovery code is written.

steps.name: Discovery evidence ledger and queue schema
steps.acceptance: Creates salesos_discovery_candidates (one row per discovered practice, with status), salesos_discovery_evidence (one row per fact: field, value, source_url, source_type, retrieved_at, confidence, collected_by), and salesos_discovery_queue (persistent job queue: id, job_type, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at). Evidence is stored separately from any generated summary — no bot may write directly to a narrative field.

steps.name: Territory Planner (deterministic)
steps.acceptance: Given one approved Nevada territory (e.g. Henderson zip codes), generates discovery queue jobs, tracks completion, and reports coverage estimate. Pure deterministic logic — no AI model call in this step.

steps.name: Source connector — Psychology Today directory
steps.acceptance: Given a territory job, returns structured candidate records (name, address, phone if listed, website, specialty) from Psychology Today’s public directory only, with source URL and retrieval date on every field. Never invents a missing field. Respects robots.txt and reasonable rate limits.

steps.name: Source connector — Yelp
steps.acceptance: Given a territory job, returns structured candidate records from Yelp’s public business listings for the mental-health/counseling category, same evidence discipline as SALESOS-PDISC-004. Second connector, not first — proves the connector pattern generalizes before adding more sources.

steps.name: Candidate extraction and entity resolution
steps.acceptance: Merges candidates from both connectors using deterministic matching first (website domain, phone, address); only escalates to a model call for genuinely ambiguous matches. Deduplicates against existing crm_contacts before creating a new candidate. Ambiguous merges route to a review queue, never auto-merge silently.

steps.name: Discovery pilot acceptance test
steps.acceptance: End-to-end run against the one approved pilot territory: real candidate list produced, every field source-linked, zero fabricated records, coverage estimate reported, and the output list is directly consumable by SALESOS-P1-002 (paste-a-URL research pipeline) for each discovered practice.

steps.name: DB migration for SalesOS practice tables
steps.acceptance: Creates salesos_practice_profiles, salesos_meeting_kits, salesos_call_sessions with user_id and practice URL; reuses crm_contacts for CRM of record. If generalizing existing tables, migration decouples from boldtrail_agents.

steps.name: Practice research pipeline
steps.acceptance: Given a URL, returns structured research using web-search-service and site-builder-opportunity-scorer, with all fields labeled KNOW/THINK/GUESS.

steps.name: Meeting kit generator
steps.acceptance: Returns a one-screen meeting kit with the 16 fields listed in PRODUCT_HOME.md.

steps.name: Founder Brief generator
steps.acceptance: Given a meeting kit and meeting date, returns a one-page brief with who, what to ask, what to avoid, close.

steps.name: CRM integration
steps.acceptance: Read/write practice records, status, next action; reuse outreach-crm contact table.

steps.name: Call script generator
steps.acceptance: Returns a bullet-point script with opening hooks, likely objections, value prop, and meeting ask.

steps.name: Follow-up email/text templates
steps.acceptance: Generates one email and one SMS per chosen lead magnet; manual send only.

steps.name: Routes and founder UI wiring
steps.acceptance: Expose POST /api/v1/salesos/research, GET/POST /api/v1/salesos/practices, GET /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/kit, POST /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/brief, POST /api/v1/salesos/practices/:id/script, and add a SalesOS stack view to lifeos-app.html.

steps.name: Phase 1 acceptance test
steps.acceptance: End-to-end run against production: research a real or fixture therapist URL, generate kit, brief, CRM record, and script.

steps.name: Manual call outcome logging
steps.acceptance: Founder can record meeting/curiosity/referral score, notes, and next action per call.

steps.name: Commitment extraction from notes
steps.acceptance: Parse call notes into decision_outcome_ledger entries with owner, deadline, and source timestamp; human confirms before writing.

steps.name: Meeting recap generator
steps.acceptance: Generate a recap from call outcome and commitment ledger.

steps.name: Referral engine
steps.acceptance: Track warm introductions and referral sources linked to a practice.

steps.name: Call recording consent feature
steps.acceptance: consent_registry supports a call_recording feature with jurisdiction-aware disclosure/consent workflow.

steps.name: Twilio outbound recording flow
steps.acceptance: Initiate outbound calls via Twilio with Record/Stream, store recording URL and transcript in salesos_call_sessions.

steps.name: Evidence Layer integration
steps.acceptance: Link audio, transcript, CRM history, calendar, email, SMS, and meeting outcome to a single call record.

steps.name: Tonality engine and coaching replay
steps.acceptance: Analyze audio for pace, pauses, energy, warmth, certainty, etc.; produce timeline and coaching clips.

steps.name: Sales DNA and pattern learning
steps.acceptance: Identify repeatable strengths and weaknesses across a user's calls with evidence-backed clips.

steps.name: Confidence Governor and Adaptive Attention Allocation
steps.acceptance: Implement 0-60% silent, 60-80% low-risk mention, 80-95% subtle suggestion, 95%+ interrupt thresholds; coach the bottleneck.

steps.name: Human Performance Engine decision
steps.acceptance: Founder decides whether the engine becomes a shared core service or remains a SalesOS domain layer; at least one other domain must need the same loop.

non_goals: No live call recording or transcription in Phase 1
No automated outbound dial/SMS without explicit consent in any phase
No replacement for Outreach CRM or BoldTrail as CRM of record
No cross-domain Human Performance Engine in Phase 1 — only capture the concept for Phase 4
No real-time coaching UI in Phase 1
open_decisions: Schema strategy: generalize existing sales_call_recordings/coaching_clips tables or create new salesos_* tables
Recording legal policy: universal disclosure + affirmative consent / Nevada one-party with interstate disclosure / no recording
CRM ownership: crm_contacts + salesos_practice_profiles side table, or separate SalesOS CRM
Outbound channel: Twilio calls/SMS with consent, or manual founder action only in Phase 1
Default lead magnet: AI Practice Intelligence Report / Patient Journey Review / Therapist AI Readiness Assessment
Data retention period for research packets and call artifacts
BP_PRIORITY queue entry and priority relative to other active missions
Human Performance Engine timing: build inside SalesOS after Phase 3, or wait for a second domain
Discovery pilot geographic scope: which single Nevada territory (e.g. Henderson zip codes) proves the pipeline before any expansion.
Discovery pilot source allowlist: which 2 directories/sources are approved for the pilot (Psychology Today + Yelp proposed) before adding more.
Discovery-to-Phase-1 handoff: does a discovered candidate auto-populate SALESOS-P1-002’s URL input, or does the founder still choose which discovered practices to research first?

Full-scale discovery (all of Nevada, all directory types, the complete bot architecture the founder specified) is explicitly NOT this mission — it is the next mission once the pilot proves accuracy and cost per real record.
